## Put your values into practice

A value describes how you want to act; it is not a feeling you must achieve first. After choosing a direction, identify one small action and what may make it difficult. Address practical barriers, and consider whether you can make room for an uncomfortable thought or feeling.

[Unhooking from Thoughts](/tool-finder/act-unhooking/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} and [Making Room for Feelings](/tool-finder/act-making-room/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} can help with inner obstacles. Use [Values Review](/tool-finder/values-review/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} to learn from what happens.

Additional ACT guidance informed by Russ Harris, [*The Happiness Trap*](https://thehappinesstrap.com/), supplied 33-chapter edition, Chapters 24-28 and 31.
